LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RemovalExport: Back up and export a save for removal
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RemovalConfirm:
The game will pause, disable new content for this save, and create a backup and a cleaned copy without overwriting existing saves.
The copy will replace this mod's character backgrounds, factions and storyteller with available alternatives. Its traits, genes, health conditions, memories, items, areas, letters and tasks will be removed. The characters themselves remain Ratkin.
After export, exit the game, remove only this mod, keep Ratkin and other dependencies, restart and load the cleaned copy. Do not overwrite it with the current running save. Unknown references will abort export with a diagnostic. Continue?
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RemovalFailed: Cleanup export did not complete. Do not remove the mod based on this attempt. New content is disabled for this save. Backup name: {0} (may not exist if saving failed). Reason: {1} See the log for details. Existing saves were not overwritten.
